scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Only typed dominating/locating-dominating vertex partitions of labeled simple cycles of length at least five. This is a complete cardinality-refined classification. Univariate coefficients coincide with previously known OEIS A001636 and are not claimed as new. Conventional transfer matrices used. Finite brute checks are corroborative, not proof; no independent audit has been performed. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Bivariate enumeration of dominating--locating-dominating partitions of cycles
